notes.title: NEW MAP! NEW ZOMCATS! LORE? Version 0.83
notes.content:
[h1]Whats new:[/h1]

A NEW MAP CALLED
[h1]THE LAB[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751462/29c43a2710f5ac1068784b65a5e716ea0de1fe97.png[/img]

[i]With a new Villain who is voiced by Kasmo![/i] 
No spoilers ;)

-Added a trigger in the Prison map to unlock the new Lab map
-New doors which will open after reaching a certain wave


[h1]2 New Zomcats![/h1]

[b]Agent Zomcat[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751462/e99b1cd14f3ad5afe4d301bcc272b0ee72ed6abc.png[/img]
[i]Can enrage himself and sprints at you.[/i]

[b]Special Agent Zomcat[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751462/f95e4bdd487e4e3ffed3ce9806487ae2b50f40fa.png[/img]
[i]Can enrage himself and sprints at you, will revive himself after dying once.[/i]



[h1]5 Free New Cosmetics[/h1]

[b]Special Agent Helmet[/b] (Animated)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751462/ac52f204bdc18c16b44dc1d4ac1df77ee3bc3a0a.png[/img]
(Can only be obtained by beating the Lab)

[b]and 4 workshop cosmetics all made by[/b] [i]Eeve[/i]

[b]Sombrero[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751462/405be8bc8174f381180cc3ab9f3f0107e7982620.png[/img]

[b]Poncho[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751462/702f194f5bd74cf8261ccfcec9cbbd15b9fee065.png[/img]

[b]Plush Cap[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751462/37549c62bdb69a8a3342cc2d30141f65f4126482.png[/img]

[b]ZomBox[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751462/16bc3b65e1127698f3d6693715d0c9e88e68f9fa.png[/img]




[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

-Fixed a bug if you open the keybind menu ingame that all the text breaks

-Fixed a bug where your inventory does not load

-Fixed a bug where you could not buy weapons or use vending machines

-Fixed a bug where you can choose the Prison map in the lobby without having it unlocked




[b]Thank you all so much for supporting me and my game, its tough to work on a game alone but it motivates me to watch you guys have fun playing my games! :D

I love all of you![/b]
[i]-sincerly Tinky[/i]

notes.title: Version 0.82 Defend the Garden!
notes.content:
Welcome to Version 0.82!

[h1][b]Whats new:[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751462/a0573a1dd412a2e08b72c34bab935b12bff94794.png[/img]
[i]Added a new small map with a new objective.
Defend the garden from the hungry Zomcats![/i]


[b]The first music disc has been added!
The FNAT Music Disc can be obtained by owning the FNAT Soundtrack![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751462/1e7e20d93d4c9b078a06267f3817ad18ac0f323c.png[/img]

You can buy the soundtrack here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2289060/Five_Nights_at_Tinkys_Soundtrack/


With the new map comes a new vending machine!
The weapon vending machine, pay 1000$ (not real $ ofcourse) to receive a random weapon or healing item!

[b]With the new vending machine comes a new achivement: "The Gambler"[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751462/b28141c3335f29c2902c959ab7105a591d0d269e.png[/img]


[h1][b]
Bug Fixes:[/b][/h1]

-Fixed a UI bug with the info text at the bottom center

-Fixed a music bug in the main menu

-Fixed usernames not updating

-Fixed missing colliders in the Prison Map



I hope you will enjoy this new Update!
Please always report bugs on my Discord. :)
-sincerly Tinky <3

notes.title: Version 0.78! 2 New Classes! 1 New BIG Map!
notes.content:
This took too long but its finally here!

[h1]Whats new:[/h1]

[b]-Added 2 new classes![/b]

[h1]Trapper[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751462/17267928011bf126cf11e7f3651f4eb4bd93223e.png[/img]
[b]Can be unlocked by reaching level 2 as Soldier and he can place deadly bear traps to keep the Zomcats away![/b]


[h1]Survivalist[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751462/bd5406be503f3ddf40cabe45dd2606477dcb72d1.png[/img]
Can be unlocked by reaching level 2 as Speedster, he can get a short speedboost and all stuns are delayed until his ability is ends.



[b]-Added 1 new BIG map TOWN![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751462/0d522a20ce247c6094d4256afb3f905466036bb8.png[/img]
[b]This map took very long but its finally here![/b]
[i]Please report any bugs you find or share some feedback on my discord here: [/i] https://discord.gg/27PsDbaDd6


[b]-Made some classes unlockables by reaching certain levels[/b]

[b]-Added a boat in the Town Map to unlock the Prison Map[/b]

[b]-Added Fog for the end of the map[/b]

[b]-Added new achivements for map unlocks and the new classes[/b]


[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]

-Fixed the Lobby infos being out of bounds if the resolution is too small

-Fixed some buttons going out of bounds if the resolution is too small

-Fixed the ui for the weapons you have in your inventory to be outside their boxes

-Fixed an issue with the keybind for Voice Chat

-Fixed a solid block in the water that blocks shots in the prison map

-Fixed walking while typing

-Fixed using meds while typing

-Fixed Zomcats despawning before spawning a corpse


[b]Thank you all so much for all the support, it really means alot to me![/b]
[b]I will always keep working on my game and keep it refreshing for you guys! <3[/b]
[b]Have a nice day![/b]
[i]-sincerly Tinky[/i]

notes.title: Small Update Version 0.73
notes.content:
[i]Version 0.73[/i]

[b]NEW[/b]
-Added 2 new mutators
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1153002791351091220/1271115520212467826/image.png?ex=66b77b94&is=66b62a14&hm=0f25e0032b96592abadeb41a8e3a41f77a6dfb73ed809f2f67ecab33e2bef9ab&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=482&height=258[/img]
[b]Loot+[/b]: Changes the dropchances for items of Zomcats to 100%. (If the Zomcat can drop items)
[b]Bad Blessing[/b]: Buffs all Zomcats resistance by 60%.

-Added a roof to the prison map

-Changed the Zomcats Rotations so stronger Zomcats spawn much later and weak Zomcats do not appear later.


[b]FIXES[/b]
-Fixed the roof not disappearing on the game start for clients
-Fixed the Shocking Eel animation speed
-Fixed some clipping issues with sprites on the prison map
-Deleted sprites outside of the prison map

Be sure to check out the new trailer!

Thank you all for the support and have fun! <3
-Sincerly Tinky

notes.title: Version 0.58
notes.content:
[h1]Another BIG Update![/h1]

[i]NEW:[/i]
-Clicking on items will now open a small window that gives options for the item and shows the items description.

-Added 1 new case which can be opened for a chance to receive a [i]normal[/i]/[i]shop[/i]/[i]animated[/i] item. [i](Animated Items are rare)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751462/c177b884ed9ecd5d994b50426dc30d00bee9c06e.png[/img]

-Added animated item support. (You can now upload animated cosmetics on the workshop!)

-New map [b]Infinite Rooms[/b] WIP
Everytime you buy a room, a new room will appear and the room will be randomized.
[i](Can be very buggy for now, please report bugs!)[/i]

-Added 2 new cosmetics for first time downloaders. ([i]Orange Headband[/i], [i]Green Headband[/i])

-Sprite Sorting now added, so stuff actually appears infront of you.

-New Icons for special item types like: "Normal Items", "Shop Items", "Animated Shop Items" and "Animated Items"

-Added footsteps sound and some environment sounds.

-Added the ability to see other players class in the lobby.

-Improved Prison buyable walls costs.

-After buying items you will get a notification

-Added a new "unboxing" window for found/bought/unboxed items with cool sounds! (Thanks to [i]Flowy Flow[/i])

-Added a new "supporter DLC"
-Added 10 new colors for DLC owners
-Added 1 new DLC item "Supporter Visor"


[i]Fixes:[/i]
-Main Menu Inventory optimization.
-Blurry Sprites.
-Shadows on the Prison map did not appear.
-Zomcats getting stuck because of collisions.
-Idling to receive items
-Bandana looking bad
[i]I fixed alot more but I am too stupid to remember <3[/i]


[b]Have fun with the new update everyone <3[/b]
[i]-Tinky[/i]
